data.narrative:
Ukrspecsystems is a growth-stage defense and security company founded by Kostyuk Vyacheslav Nikolaevich, currently funded through MoD contracts. The valuation universe comprises 10 comparable firms: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems drawn from a broader 23-firm Defense & Security peer set.

Traditional peer-median methodology is not applicable here. The comparable universe lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with similar valuation tiers—fewer than three datapoints survived the narrow filtering criteria required for reliable triangulation. While 23 same-sector peers exist, applying an all-sector median would introduce material methodological error and obscure stage-specific valuation dynamics in frontier defense tech.

This analysis therefore cannot produce a defensible point estimate or range without additional data. A credible valuation would require either: (1) direct revenue or EBITDA multiples from the identified 10 comparable firms, (2) transaction data from recent funding rounds in the Defense & Security growth-stage segment, or (3) discounted cash flow inputs specific to Ukrspecsystems' contract pipeline and margin structure. The current dataset is insufficient to triangulate value. Recommend gathering comparable multiples and recent exit/funding precedents before proceeding to valuation synthesis.
